notes.title: Thanks for your support!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support in those first days of Rascallz: Tiki Tiki.
The positive comments and reviews are marvellous and give me and my team motivation to work on and keep smiles on our faces in 2020, which isn't easy for anyone.
We hope all of you are well, stay healthy and have fun!
